title: Leaked Mass Effect 5 Trailer Is Real, Offers Glimpse of Cancelled Game
summary:
"We were making a great game".

A Mass Effect 5 trailer, made using “pre-production assets”, appears to have leaked on Reddit following dev BioWare’s closure this week.
